t: Collect 8 Resinous Cones and bring them to Maas-Igris in the shelter by the ruins.

Once Hulus and the Residence were one city, but then on the night of the Grreat Disaster the earth shook like an epileptic mongoose! Mountains raised there where once were sprrings, towers fell down the faults from which flames were bursting out... We abandoned Hulus and thought it was cursed.

Now only one path leads there. Tya-ah are guarding that path, and they will make much ado if they see Pridens on it. We will have to distrract them... I know a way to do that!

Tya-ah are stupid. They haven't mastered fire, and they are afraid of smoke. Cones of local firs produce caustic smoke that will scare the hell out of them.
Gather some ten cones while I am preparing the blend to fire things up, huh.
The greener are the cones, the more smoke they will prroduce. I will dip them in this blend to make them flammable, eysh!
Dip 10 arrows into venom of Poisonous Centipedes and return to Maas-Igris in his shelter near the ruins.

I have one more request, kylys. I'm afraid that some tya-ah will start screaming and alarm the rest of them. We can't let this happen, eysh!

I will give you several arrows; dip them into venom of local centipedes. If any of the tya-ah opens their mouth, I will drive an arrow right into it! Centipedes' venom instantly paralyzes muscles, so they won't even make a sound.
The bow strring has loosen... I will make a new one out of our enemies' sinews!
Thank you, kylys. I've always detested insects. I would rather touch a live coal than a centipede, eysh!
Reach the ruins under the cover of smoke from burning cones.

Everything is set, kylys. Before we attack, we need to find out what is going on inside of the ruins. If everything's clear, our hunters need to reach Hulus unnoticed, and then upon Maas-Yarin's signal, they will break inside of it and kill off all the tya-ah, eysh!

But don't reveal yourself too soon. Use the burning cones to sneak inside safely and see what's going on there. I will cover your back. Don't worry about me, eysh!
Who are you? What do you want?
No, no! Don't eat us! We are insipid and poisonous!
Kill 10 stray tya and report to goolga Laan-Kul in the Residence.

Enlightened... The one who stepped beyond and returned... Now speaks with the spirits!

Are you surprised? The Primals rarely do appear among the living ones, and even less often they can see us.

Yao Realm has let you out, but a part your tya remained inside, in the spirits' world. That was the price of it, child, your gift and your curse. You exist in two worlds, and you see them both. I will show you...

Here, in the Residence, dwells tya of your misfortunate kinsmen that you call tya-ah. They can't reach Yao Realm, and their tya is suffering in pain.

Give them freedom, child. Slay your enemies, but be merciful to the fallen, for balance is the essence of creation!
Sorry, what? Makchirgue spoke to you? Then you should listen to her words. The Primals are hardly ever wrong!

Makchirgue told you to be merciful to stray tya of our enemies? That's a strange advice... But who am I to contradict the will of the Primals? They don't rule over us like the Golases do, but they speak words of wisdom!
Kill 12 tya-ah near the Maas Camp and report to Maas-Yarin the Sharp-Eyed.

I hate to admit that, but I would gladly use some help, eysh!

We were lured into a trap. We chased after the tya-ah and reached the ravine... There they first rained heavy stones on our heads, then attacked us with weapons in their hands! Savages! With weapons! Unbelievable...

Very few survived. Tya-ah chased us back all the way to the camp, eysh! There are still many of them prrowling around. If you can kill a dozen of them, you will be a brrother of our Branch, eysh!
Damned outlanders... They've taught tya-ah how to use weapons and lay ambushes. What next? Crossbows and Astral cannons?
On behalf of the Maas Branch, I thank you, kinsman. Even if you enter another Branch, we will still be in your debt!
Bring 12 Tinder Roots to Maas-Hala in the Maas Camp.

Aho! Sorry, I don't have time for talking. I've changed so many bandages and blended so many ointments I've been run off my paws! I'm afraid, many of our warriors won't make it till the morning.

Will you help me, zoor? There's a lot of Tinder grrowing outside of the camp. Its roots are grreat for burning out the infection. Each root can save someone's life, eysh!
I'm a huntress and a healer of the Maas Branch, not some Khoor seamstress! But today I can't let the needle out of my hands...
Thank you! This is just what I needed. The Maas Branch won't forget your kindness!
Kill 12 Vultures, burn 8 bodies of tya-ah and return to Maas-Reckay in the Hunters' Camp.

Do you hear that squawking? Those are scavengers, gathering for the lunch... Nasty birds!

When we retrreated, we took the bodies with us. Pridens don't leave the dead to be eaten by animals! But the savages don't care. The dead bodies will lie there until vultures carry away their bones and the grround soaks in their dead blood. You know what happens then? Hunhurrs, black souls will be born out of the dead blood, seeking revenge on their killers!

Someone has to get rid of the blatant birds and the savages' bodies. Let them burn in the cleansing flames!
I hate vultures. They steal all the bones and spread the dead blood...
Ay-hya! Good job, frriend! It would be grreat if you could join the Maas Branch one day...
Feel the Thrill of Blood by killing an enemy, increase it tenfold, and return to Ekhe-Hoor near the Maas Camp.

Ah, young hunter... What do you want from Ekhe? Very few of you have preserved that rage and power that were bestowed upon our people. You don't know what a real thrill is - the rapture that you feel when you drive your fangs into a victim's throat... And you don't stop, no. You rush on, crushing enemies and striking out right and left... You forget yourself, you're not a warrior anymore - you're all pure battle fury!

Do you want to feel it? Go on and try! Slay your enemies and don't let the blood dry on your blade! Become more than just a warrior, become the war itself!
The smell of blood that comes from you isn't strrong enough, hunter.

Hahaha! You never fail to amaze us, child. It was a great hunt, wasn't it? There is nothing sweeter than the blood of your enemy, hahaha!

Remember that feeling, child. Power, rage, and thrill - that is what makes a true Priden!
Complete quests from Maas-Hala, Maas-Khynya, and Maas-Reckay and return to Maas-Yarin in the camp.

We have sworn to fulfill the blood right, and we will take our enemies' blood even if we have to kill them with our bare hands!

Unfortunately, our wounds won't let us brreak into the ruins, where the tya-ah are hiding, and wipe them out. We will have to take them by artifice, eysh! I have a plan of an alternate attack.

Talk to my soldiers - they will gladly use some help. We will pay you back in kind, eysh!
Don't hasten. We hastened and we paid for it.
Alright, we are ready. And this time we won't fail!

Collect 8 Toadstools, soak them in the bile of slugs crawling by the spring, sublime them into a mixture using the still, then imbue the mixture with rage of bloodthirsty hunhurrs dwelling among the ancient tombs, and return to Maas-Hala in the camp.

Many of our hunters are wounded and weakened, but I know a potion that can invigorate them. Trappers know a secret recipe of a potion that can double or even triple their strength and put such rage into their hearts that even mountains will tremble with fear, eysh! We call it the Animality Potion, and outlanders pay a good deal for it.

You know much about herbs - you can tell Tinder from Hemlock. This is why I am asking you to help again.

First, get some Toadstools. If you soak freshly picked mushrooms in the bile of slugs that crawl by the spring and then sublime it into a mixture, you will get that mind-blowing stuff. But don't try it yourself, eysh!

Before usage, the potion has to be subdued with rage and anger. I saw a couple of hunhurrs among the tombs. These things are as angry as a dozen savages!
Don't drink it! It will ruin your life if you get used to it...
Let me smell it... Whoa! That stuff punches you in the nose, eysh!
Give the Animality Potion to 5 wounded Pridens and return to Maas-Hala.
Just give the potion to five wounded hunters, and you will see the effect for yourself, huh! But let them drink more than one sip, or they will destroy the whole village!
Go on, don't hesitate. There should be no fear in your heart when you go to battle!
The effect is rather impressive, zoor? One shouldn't take too much of it, it is extremely addictive, eysh!
Kill 10 Bloodthirsty Hunhurrs among the ancient tombs and find what has attracted them, then return to Maas-Reckay in the Maas Camp.

Why are there so many hunhurrs here? I've never seen more than one at a time, but there at the Northern cemetery there are dozens of them. I'm afraid for the wounded that cannot join us in battle. I don't want to return to their bloodless bodies. And I also would like to know what they are among the tombs, eysh!

Kill those bloodthirsty hunhurrs that prowl around, and try to find what attracts them - it's better to destroy the root of evil than to fight its sprouts, eysh!
Did you find anything interesting, Enlightened?
It's good that you've found a way to drrive the hunhurrs away. The bad thing is, someone has lured them here deliberately... Our enemy is more dangerous than we thought. Ay-hya! Much more dangerous!
Break the dagger and defeat the Soul-sucking Hunhurr trapped inside, then report to Maas-Reckay in the Hinters' Camp.

So the hunhurrs were attracted by a dead body on the ancient altar? That's weird... Those altars were had been here before our people came, so even the Primals can't tell us about the gods that their builders were worshipping, eysh!

Let me take a closer look at it... This is not our weapon. This patters is really strange, I haven't seen anything like that even on the outlanders' weapons. And also... Shoysh!

Now I can see why hunhurrs were drragged to this thing. Tya of the killed is contained inside of that dagger! It was not just trrapped - the torment that tya went through before dying has turned it into a very strong hunhurr!

If we brreak the dagger, it will be released, and you won't defeat it single-handedly. And if we don't break it... we will never know if I were right. It's up to you to decide, eysh!
Take your frriends with you, Enlightened, if you want to brreak the dagger. You won't defeat the thing that's inside of it single-handedly.

That poor fellow was sacrificed deliberately. Our enemy is pure evil if even hunhurrs obey him. Deprive tya from being able to return to the river of life and lock it up in cold metal... I can't even imagine someone who is capable of such a misdeed, eysh!
Bring 12 fangs of Saber-toothed Tigers and 14 branches of Soulbrier to Maas-Khynya in the Hunters' Camp.

Maas-Yarin has ordered me to guard the camp. Phew! Were was his caution when his hunters were so foolishly trrapped?

Speaking of which. I need some fangs of Saber-toothed Tigers and branches of Soulbrier to make new traps. If we set them around the camp, not a single tya-ah will reach it, eysh!
Be careful with Soulbrier. You can get stuck in it, and then it will smother you with its brranches. A dead body is a grreat fertilizer!
Wow, such sharp fangs! And the brranches are very lithe - right what we need! They will make good traps. I swear on my ancestors - it will be easier to chop off your foot than to get it out of them!
Set traps around the camp and return to Maas-Khynya.

Now we only have to set the traps around the camp.

Put six of them closer to the paths, and I will set the rest of them among the cliffs. Hide them well - stupid as they are, tya-ah are still a little smarter than wild animals...
Put them closer to the paths, and I will go further and set a couple more surprises.
Job's done! Not a single crreature will approach the camp unnoticed. You can go and tell Maas-Yarin that everything's ready.
Meet Maas-Igris near the ruins of Hulus.

Well done, Enlightened. I'm sure now the camp is safe.

Listen; there's another thing. We learn from our mistakes, and we won't be trapped so easily for the second time. I have sent several hunters to scout in the ruins of the old city, where tya-ah are hiding. Maas-Igris is their commander, he is a good hunter, but not the smartest one. I think it will be better if you see everything for yourself.

Go to the ruins, find Maas-Igris, and find out as much as you can about tya-ah and the outlanders that were with them during the raid on the Residence.
Hush! Don't make noise. There are many evil ears and eyes around...
Find Maas-Esha near the Shoom Mound.

One more thing... When I heard about hunhurrs, I remembered one old story and sent our spellcaster to see if my conjecture was correct. I won't tell you the story, Maas-Esha knows the legends better than me. Find her near the ancient ruins. She will need your help.
Aho, kinsman! What brings you to these forgotten lands?
Destroy 10 skeletons near the Shoom Mound and return to Maas-Esha.

Warriors of the Shoom Branch were buried in this Mound. Many moons ago Golas Shoom revolted against the rest of the Golases and spilled the blood of his brothers, thus dooming his Branch to death, eysh!

It happened after Pridens of the Shoom Branch found an ancient Portal that led to some distant allod. Those who followed the Golas through it, came back changed. Their minds were fogged. They turned away from the Primals and prraised someone called Tep. They sacrificed their brrothers from other Branches to him!

The Golases punished the apostates. Their tya were sealed in that Mound along with damned Golas Shoom, the Portal was destroyed, and Howlem was isolated from the rest of the world.

But now there are crrowds of undead here, which means someone has opened the burial and released tya of the trraitors. We have to destroy them, eysh!
Strike with no mercy, Enlightened. The trraitors don't deserve mercy!
It's bad... Very bad... We have turned several dozens of dump skeletons into dust, and they won't stop coming. We will have to take a risk!
Defeat Golas Shoom in the Mound and find out who released the undead.

Spellcasters from our tribe put powerful charms on the Mound to keep tya of the trraitors contained. But now I don't feel anything, eysh! The charms were dispelled, and nothing keeps the villains in their grraves... We need to seal the Mound again!

Are you with me, zoor? We need to reach the old Shoom Tower where their Golas was locked up, and seal his cell again!

Haha! You think you can lock me up in my old cell for good? What a hope!

There always will be someone who will release me, like those foolish tailless...

They didn't even know anything about Yao Realm and the rest of the Golases. The outlanders will do all the dirty work for me. I will come back, and Pridens will only have one Golas, haha! Great Tep will restore my body and make me immortal!
Return to Maas-Hala in the Hunters' Camp.

This is unbelievable... How can someone be this vile? He has betrayed his brrothers, his people, just to be granted immortality? Tep... remember that name, Enlightened! If he had poisoned the mind of one of the most virtuous Golases, I can hardly imagine the evil that lives in his heart.

Shoom will be locked up in his cell, and he won't escape again, I swear on the gifts of the Primals! Go to Maas-Hala and tell her everything. She will pass the message to everyone else. Together we will find a way to brring the Golases back!

Calm down and tell me everything.

So Golas Shoom has returned to our world and betrrayed us twice by telling the outlanders about Yao Realm and the Golases? This is too bad... Now I'm sure the Golases have gone silent unwillingly, eysh!

I will brring the bitter news to the Residence, and meanwhile you should go to Hulus, Enlightened. I'm afraid only you can find out what our enemies are up to!
Kill 10 Sharp-Sighted Tya-ah and their 3 tailless commanders near the ruins, then come back to Maas-Igris in his shelter.

Maas-Yarin was right - the outlanders want something in the ruins of the old city, eysh!

They are obviously expecting another attack, and they are prreparing for it. The tailless enemies have picked out the most sharp-sighted tya-ah and they boss them like dogs. Ay-hya! If we don't get rid of their guards, there is no way that we can stay unnoticed.
Be careful, Enlightened. There are more enemies than you think!
You killed them before they even noticed you... You are destined to become a grreat warrior, Enlightened!
Talk to Log the Rugged or Yasskul Tabhut, disguise as an outlander, and talk to Boo, chief of tya-ah.

So you're not one of them? Hurray! We knew somebody would come looking for us!

The savages sniffed us and even wanted to taste us, but their chief didn't let them. He asked us something on their language, but I didn't get it.

Hide before they come back! The savages killed all Pridens that they saw. They hate you more than the Empire hates the League.

I know! If you disguise as one of us, they will never guess. They will think you are just another captive! Then you will find out what they want from us!
Who are you? I don't know you.
Eh. You come. You smell weird. What do you want, eh?
Find a disguise and put it on to talk to Boo.
You are suspicious. Your name Bullguy? No? Then get lost! Off you go!
You're still here? Hah! Where is my club?!
O, hallo. Where you been? I'm in charge here! I say "Boo!" and they run scared! This is why I am called Boo.
Who are you? You're from Uuk's pack? Tell him he's an ass!
First you will fight with our warriors. I will watch. I am smart, I will learn.
You fight fast. I didn't get it. Will you show again?
I think yes. Fight me! I will defeat you!
Complete tya-ah's quests and talk to Boo.

You smart? You get me?

I am Boo! I am the chief.

You will build our house. And cook. And light fire. We will learn to cook and light. Like Pridens. And fight. You know how to fight?

One Priden promised to teach us. To cook and to fight. He told us other Pridens were bad. Because they didn't teach us. And he would.

He lied! You won't lie. If you lie, I will eat you. Teach us, then I will let you go. I am in charge. So I say!
You won't cheat? We will burn fire like Pridens?
You are good outlander. We love you!
Earn 10,000 reputation points with tya-ah and talk to Boo.
We found a thingy in the tower. We will give it to you. Not now, later. When you prove that you are our friend. Best friend, eh!
You are our best friend! Others shoo us. They laugh. Or kill. And you are our friend. Take this thingy.
Earn 25,000 reputation points with tya-ah and talk to Boo.
We have another thingy. Even better one. But we won't give it to you, too. You are our friend, but we don't trust you. You can break it. Or lose it.
We don't trust you. We won't give you the thingy.
Alright. We trust you. Take the thingy. Don't break it!
Try to teach the savages how to fight. Defeat several opponents and talk to Boo.

We know how to fight. With claws, teeth, club. I am the smartest. I have the biggest club. That's why I'm the chief!

We want to fight like Pridens. To defeat Pridens and live in their houses.

All outlanders know how to fight. We saw. Will you show us how to fight? We will defeat all Pridens. And let you go.
Show us how to fight. We will beat everyone!
I see. Not bad. Will you show it again?
Destroy 12 angry tyallas and find what lured them into the ruins, then return to Boo.

Strangers live in the ruins. White, and black, and scary. We are afraid of them.

They came from the temple. When Priden opened the temple, they came out in crowds.

Shoo the strangers! I saw how outlanders make light. Then boom! And everyone's dead. Priden did it, too.

Will you shoo the strangers? I will tell about the temple and the Priden!
Shoo the strangers. They piss me off!

Priden wanted to enter the temple. I don't know what for. Wanted very much. He even stabbed another Priden.

Then the strangers appeared. And the temple opened. Or he first stabbed, then it opened? I don't remember.
Break the dagger, defeat the trapped hunhurr, and talk to Boo.

What is this? A dagger? Who was stabbed with it? Priden? And the strangers came?

No, it's a bad dagger. Small and evil. Break it! I don't want the strangers!
What are you looking at? Break the dagger.
What was that? That was a big one! He was inside of the dagger? Huh...
Try to teach the savages how to fight. Defeat several opponents and talk to Boo.

We know how to fight. With claws, teeth, club. I am the smartest. I have the biggest club. That's why I'm the chief!

We want to fight like Pridens. To defeat Pridens and live in their houses.

All outlanders know how to fight. We saw. Will you show us how to fight? We will defeat all Pridens. And let you go.
Show us how to fight. We will beat everyone!
I see. Not bad. Will you show it again?
Obtain snake meat, collect stones, slip off a branch, start fire next to Hah, and show her how to fry meat.

I'm Hah! Boo is my man. He's the best. He gives me apples because I'm beautiful!

I want to cook good food. And make fire. All Pridens can cook and make fire. And we don't. It's not fair! I want to cook, too!

Will you show me? You are outlander. Outlanders can make fire. We saw.

I stole fried meat from outlanders. Very tasty meat. And hot as fire!

You can cook meat? Show me!
I want fried meat. Of a fat snake. Very tasty.

Tasty! Yum! You are good. Almost like Boo. And smart, too!

But I didn't get it. Will you show again?
Obtain snake meat, collect stones, slip off a branch, start fire next to Hah, and show her how to fry meat.

I'm Hah! Boo is my man. He's the best. He gives me apples because I'm beautiful!
I want to cook good food. And make fire. All Pridens can cook and make fire. And we don't. It's not fair! I want to cook, too!
Will you show me? You are outlander. Outlanders can make fire. We saw.
I stole fried meat from outlanders. Very tasty meat. And hot as fire!
You can cook meat? Show me!
I want fried meat. Of a fat snake. Very tasty.

Tasty! Yum! You are good. Almost like Boo. And smart, too!

But I didn't get it. Will you show again?
Go to the gates of the upper part of the temple in the Hulus' ruins and speak to Tooraah.

Good. I think I got it. And my girlfriend likes you. And you killed the strangers. You are a good outlander. When we defeat Pridens, I will give you three wives. And a club. Almost like mine!

Tell the outlanders they are free. We are now smart! And strong! Bad Priden won't cheat on us again! There is no food in the temple. He will soon come out, and we will kill him! And all the bad outlanders. And beat other packs, so that they don't listen to the bad outlanders. They will listen to me! I am smart, eh!
Wait, child! Don't approach the gates of the temple - they are guarded by a strange spell that is unknown to the Primals...
Return things stolen by tya-ah and scattered in the ruins to the Shaggy Family.

It's a good thing that you found a way to get through to the dumb savages! They even don't know how to light fire. They just eat everything they see. They ate my leather bag and scattered everything that was inside of it, thick bastards!

Listen, will you get our belongings back? The savages know you already!
Ah, I think our things are gone... And we've carried them all the way from Lightwood!
Oh, thank you! Do you have anything strong to drink? I wouldn't mind a sip after all the turmoil...
Obtain 12 bat wings in the ruins and bring them to Sarbaz Mehud.

There is a positive side in being captured. For example, I have plenty of spare time to analyze the behavior of our soldiers during the savages' raid and find a way to increase our defensive capacity.

Also, I have discovered a new species of bats! I will devote my monograph to it... If I obtain a sample.

I'm afraid that if I try to catch a bat in the ruins, the savages may misinterpret my actions and damage my prosthesis... They've already torn off a couple of wires!

Will you help me? I will mention your name in my research paper. What was it, again?
I can't wait to leave these ruins and get back to the interrupted research.

Brilliant! Look at this unusual metacarpal structure! The second phalange is shifted towards the radius bone... Very interesting. Do you think it would be too arrogant to call the new species with my name?
Use the Crow Eye to dispel the charms that bind the power of the Eternal Guards and return to Tooraah.

Caw! A dark force has infiltrated the Temple... Our enemies are not from the League or from the Empire, they come from the depths of the Great Nothing. They want to take everything that survived the Great Disaster. They are known as Demons all over the world...

For many moons Demons didn't disturb us. The Temple protects our land from the Great Nothing. The power of the guards' statues keeps the spawns of the void away the Temple.

But now evil sorcery has entangled the statues and drained their strength... Caw! Release them, child! Take my eye - it will let you see things invisible even to your gaze.
Hurry up, child! The fate of our people may depend on you!

The guards are awakened, child. Now don't let the spawn of the void leave the Temple!

It's a shame I can't pick his eyes out myself...
Destroy the spell on the Temple gates using the Crow Eye, defeat the Demons, and talk to Tooraah.

We have almost no power in your world, child. There are just the four of us, four Primals that didn't leave this world, abiding by the will of the Creator. We are the echo of his power, not his children. This world belongs to you and to the void; so was the design.

We are just the hand that directs the spear, and you are destined to become the spear itself, child.
Are you ready? Look into my eye; feel our power, and entwine it into the spearhead... Become the spear and strike! Strike without a miss!
Don't fear, child. Fear ill becomes a savior of creation!
We were right about you, child... Heroes like yourself are rarely born under the stars!
Kill 10 Demons in the Temple and find doolga Saad-Wayway.

The spawns of the void are swarming inside of the Temple, but I know your hand will be firm. Tonight the Great Nothing won't satisfy its hunger!

I can feel two hearts beating under these stone vaults. One of them is dark and evil, and another one is trembling like a frightened bird, but there is no darkness in it.

Find them, child, and do what you think is right. We can't follow you inside.
Strike with no mercy, child, or the void will devour your world.
Am I dreaming? What is your name, kylys? I swear on the ancestors, it must be carved into the Temple steps next to the names of the greatest heroes of our people!
Find the traitor in the Temple, defeat him, and save his victim.

Our enemy is up to no good. I can smell him, and he smells with blood and treachery. Treachery, child! Your enemy is not a tailless outlander, he's a rotten fruit on a healthy branch... You need to burn out the rot!

Hurry, child! Your enemy is thirsty for blood, and he derives strength from killing his own brothers... Don't let him take one more life!
Hurry, child! The time of your world leaks like water from a broken jug, and only you can fix the crack!
Ay-hya! I've never believed those stories about the mighty bayazy, who comes to the rescue when you are hanging between life and death... Now I see they were true!
Destroy the seal that blocks the way to the intact part of the Temple, return to the Residence, and talk to Tyym-Khos the Black.

I swear, in a moment, Akyl would have slaughtered me like the rest of the captives. He drrinks their strength and derives his power from their blood and death throes, and tya of the killed doesn't return to the Great Circle! I've never heard of such sorcery, bayazy... But neither has anyone heard of a power that can shackle the Golases. Akyl said that his Master's gift allowed him to lure the Golases in a trap and drive the spirits out of Yao Realm, eysh!

How could we be so blind, zoor? The enemy was so close, right by the end of the enfilade... How could we not sense the hostile magic that has let the Demons right into the heart of the Residence?!

Go to Tyym-Khos, bayazy! Tell him to call all the Branches, all doolgas, all crafters... We can't be late, eysh!
What? What are you doing here, Enlightened?! The Temple was sealed before the ancestors of your ancestors were born!
Talk to Igor Chudin and Yulia Kolesnikova about Akyl's treachery and the Black Stone found in the Yao Realm, then speak with Tyym-Khos the Black.

I can't believe my ears... Akyl is a ship captain, one of the few ones who are allowed to moor at Howlem. I've known him since we were toothless cubs, eysh! He decided to devote his life to trravelling instead of joining a Branch, but he was always loyal to our people! We are such akaras...

So who's that Master Akyl's been talking about? I don't know much about Tep, but I've heard he could command Demons. And what does this all have to do with the Black Stone?

I hope the tailless outlanders can give us the answers. Akyl and the rest of the enemies came from their lands, after all!
Have you found out anything important, kylys?

The Black Stone is the key to ancient Portals, zoor? Now I can see how the trraitor was pulling our paws, eysh! Did the tailless say anything about the Master? No? That's a pity. An unknown enemy is the most dangerous one!

Talk to Maas-Shosha about the Portal. Doolgas know more about those magical things than anyone.
Oh, hello! I was sent here to speak on behalf of the League. Before the Imperial ambassador stuffs your head with their dumb propaganda. Besides, your commander is so... manly.

I know who you are talking about. His name was Akyn or Akyl, right? He was trying to hit on me back in the Port with his raunchy jokes.

He offered to run our ship to Howlem. There is no way we could have reached it on our own, with all the storms and anomalies! While we were travelling, I came to the deck to take a look at your beautiful allod, and then I saw several Astral boats undocking from the ship ahead and heading to a small shard near your allod. I didn't pay much attention to that, but now it's clear to me that Akyl has sent his accomplices there!

Magical stone? Let me have a look... Oh! Don't you know what it is? It's a June Adventurer's Stone!

This stone is used to create a small Portal and travel to a certain stationary Portal from anywhere in the world! Also, it can arouse magic of ancient June Portals. Although I don't know the required spells. I'm just an ambassador, not a Great Mage. We could use some help from one right now!

The Holy Land is a truly wondrous allod. This ancient land was once home to the June, and after their demise it became home to the Zem. It is also where Tep himself built a colossal pyramid ages ago.

After the final battle of the Great Astral Campaign, this pyramid became home to the soul of Tensess, the Great Kanian Mage. After that the pyramid became known as Tensess Temple, and it is from there that all of the world's Holy magic originates.

The Empire seeks to capture the Temple and take control of the world's Holy magic. That would drain the power from all of the League's priests and paladins. Even worse, it would deprive us of the ability to be reborn after death.

For years now we've been warring with the Empire in the Holy Land. And though our cause is just, victory is a long ways off.
Talk to Saad-Hoodoock, adjust the Portal using the Black stone, and teleport to the Howlem's shard where the enemies are hiding.

I'm sorry, Enlightened, but... I don't know how to help you. None of us can control Portals and open new passages. The Golases are strict... were strict about it. The fate of the Shoom Branch served a lesson for all those who thought they can fly over the sun.

But I know who can, eysh! Saad-Hoodoock has been trying to plumb the secrets of the Junes, who had lived here, for a long time. Talk to him - he's a petulant and grouchy old man, but no one knows more about the Junes than he does.
Don't bother me over nothing, kinsman. I'm too old for your fuss!
You did it! I swear on the ancestors' spirits, you did it!

We have the key, and we have the lock. They are connected, but you can't turn the key if you put it in upside down, eysh!

Listen and do what I say, kylys. I believe we can make it. The Primals are favoring us!
Get ready, kylys. Listen to the harmony of the world and open the lock!
Use the June Portal ruins to teleport to the Howlem's shard, use the Heart of the Pack and discover where the Golases are help captive.

Kylys... Though you're not a kylys, you're a true bayazy! I wish I could go with you, but only one of us can control the stone.

Do you understand that the fate of our people is in your hands, zoor? You either kill the enemies and release the Golases, or we are all doomed! There is no way we can resist the void and its swarms without the Golases.

Take my talisman, the Heart of the Pack. Once the Golases gave it the ancestor of my ancestor as a reward. It will help you in battle... I think so. I don't know for sure, I've never used its power.

I believe in you, Enlightened. Go!
Ha! I knew that our descendants are not all good-for-nothing!
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

Go to the spirits' world with Golas Saad's help, spill your blood on the ground, and wait for Scar and Baccy to appear. Defeat them both and let the Heart of the Pack absorb their power. Return to Golas Tyym.

It looks like Golas Laan was right when he said that no good should be expected from the outlanders. For the first time in many centuries Pridens are confronting a real threat, and we are not even able to help! Look where it has brrought us, eysh!

But Saad-Hoodoock is wearing a doolga's skin for a reason. Even when his mind comes to a standstill, his heart shows him the way. Do you know what you are holding in your hands? It's the Heart of the Pack. All our essence, our history, all strength of Pridens is now in your fist, eysh! And that strength will abide you if your will is strong enough, and your loyalty to your people is unswerving.

May your path lead you to the spirits' world. You will need the best help you can find to win this battle. The outlanders have awakened the age-old enemies of Pridens - the Tiger and Jackal spirits that you've already met during your trials. You defeated them once, now it's time for you to make them go for good! Spill your blood on the consecrated ground and be ready - they will come following the smell. The Heart of the Pack will give you strength to fight them. Believe in yourself, and believe in our wisdom. Golas Saad will guide your spirit. Go dignified!
What are you waiting for, child? Hurry up - our fate is hanging by a thread!
The spirits have come to your call, eysh! The Heart of the Pack helped us again. Now there's little left to do.

Don't fear anything, child. The spirit' world will tolerate no weakness. I will be your guide, but remember - when the time comes for the final battle, I won't be able to help you. Your victory or your defeat will belong to you solely.

The world of spirits is just as dangerous as yours, child. You've had to learn the rules of your world to survive, hadn't you, zoor? Now you must learn the rules of the spirits' world, too. First of all, remember - your will sculptures the world like pottery clay. As long as you know what you want, the dangers will pass you by.

Think of your enemies and concentrate on that thought. They are your purpose and your prey. All you need is to obtain their power to summon the patron spirits, and use their help to eliminate the threat that is hanging over Pridens.

Remember about that. Let your instincts do the rest, eysh!
h: Ask about the dangers of the spirits' world

t: Kill 12 Demons on the Howlem's shard and report back to Golas Khuus.

You are a good warrior. Me and my kinsmen will fight over you at the Council! Each of us would be happy to have such a kylys in their Branch.

The spawns of the void are everywhere. Now that we are free, they pose no threat to the Residence, but they are still dangerous. If you can send a couple dozens of them back to void, I will compose a song about your feats, eysh!
Don't stop until the enemy falls to your feet!
What can be better than a good fistfight, zoor? Only fame and esteem! Honestly, sometimes I want to go back in time, take my axe, and plunge into the thick of battle, like in the good old days...
Defeat the Bottomless Womb on the Howlem's shard and return to Golas Khuus.

Have you ever seen a giant sack with tentacles devouring a mountain? The spectacle is quite exciting, eysh! Foolish outlanders tried to feed us to it, but luckily for them, we are bodiless.

If I had a body, I would have winded the guts of that nasty thing around its neck! But I will have to ask you to do that for me, kinsman.
I will tear off the tail of anyone who tries to entice such a brave kylys into their Branch!
The spawns of the void have gone back to the void... Good riddance. You never fail to surprise me, eysh! I will tear off the tail of anyone who tries to entice such a brave kylys into their Branch!
Kill Priden traitor Akyl the Gray-Haired, take his papers, and destroy the Demonic Portal. Report to Tyym-Khos the Black in the Residence.

The time has come, bayazy, to drrive the foreign taint away from Howlem, and you will become the hero of our people!

The Priden traitor, Akyl the Gray-Haired, is preparing to open the magical door that will let hordes of Astral hunhurrs into our lands. I can feel that there is something wrong with Akyl, but we have no time to figure that out right now. Maybe if you go through the things of that akara after you finish him, you will find something.

We need to destroy the door for good. The spirits will help you with that, don't worry. Trust them with your life, like we trusted in you. Have a good hunt, kylys!
What are you doing here, zoor?

Ay-hya! The one who was a cub yesterday now has surpassed all warriors of Howlem! The Golases and the spirits must be really favoring you, kylys. No, don't say anything. Each Priden in these lands should kneel before you. I hope you understand it's not everyday when you can see your kinsmen kneeled, zoor?

Remember this moment, kylys. This may be the greatest feat of your life. Though I don't think so, eysh!

Now go to Khoor-Tarr. The old man has been waiting for you.
Talk to Yulia Kolesnikova and Igor Chudin in the Residence about the Holy Land and report to Tyym-Khos.

I'm afraid the most part of the papers are covered with the traitor's blood. Those lines that I can read say nothing about the Master, Tep, or the spawns of the void. But I can see that the traitor's ship has come from the Holy Land. I've never heard of it... Maybe some of the outlanders in the Residence can tell us about it?
I know nothing about those lands. Go ask the tailless - they've been all across the Astral!
So this is it? Akyl lost his mind somewhere in the Holy Land? We need to warn the tailless. They are fighting for that land, so let them deal with the threat on their own, eysh!
Commence the Golas Council and listen to their will.

Ay-hya! I was right about you, disciple. You have eliminated the threat that was hanging above our people - single-handedly! - and defeated the spawns of the void. The Branch that will accept you will become the strongest one!

The time has come to call the Council! The Golases are near, and I can feel their impatience. Bow your knee, young Priden...

Today you will receive your second name that you will bear until you die! Today you will meet your new family, and you and your kinsmen will mix your blood in the sacrificial bowl. Today the ancestors look at you from behind the Realm and rejoice!

Kneel and listen to the will of the Golases!
We didn't see that coming... But who can tell the truth if not the Golases? It's up to you to decide!
Well... It's your choice and your destiny. I can only wish you luck. The spirits of the ancestors are prroud of you, eysh!
Talk to Denis Opalubkin at the Empire ship, go to Nezebgrad, and meet Yasker in Yasker's Tower.

I don't think we will ever meet again, my best disciple. Your path is dangerous and thorny, but I believe that you will walk it with your head held high and won't brring your ancestors to shame. Remember that you are a Priden! And Pridens never yield to destiny - they forge it with their own hands, eysh!
Go to Nezebgrad, free Priden. I have already sent a message to the ship's captain. Meet Yasker and tell him about the spawns of the void and their servants in the Holy Land. May the ancestors' spirits be with you!

Greetings. I am Yasker. I believe you have heard of me?

I was told about an exceptional Priden who decided to swear allegiance to the Empire. Your kinsmen rarely leave their allod, and even less often they join the service. I ordered the City Council to compile your profile, and it seems rather peculiar to me. Especially the part which says about your battle with the Demons and your interest towards the Holy Land.

So, welcome to the Empire, comrade. We gladly accept such dignified recruits. And what are you supposed to answer to that? Right - I serve the Empire!
Greetings, comrade! I've heard that you wish swear allegiance to the great Empire. Good for you! I hope your people will see, too, that the future belongs to the Empire, and join our ranks!
Talk to the Soaked Family at the League ship, go to Novograd, and meet Aidenus in his tower on the main square.

I don't think we will ever meet again, my best disciple. Your path is dangerous and thorny, but I believe that you will walk it with your head held high and won't brring your ancestors to shame. Remember that you are a Priden! And Pridens never yield to destiny - they forge it with their own hands, eysh!
Go to Nezebgrad, free Priden. I have already sent a massage to the ship's captain. Meet Aidenus and tell him about the spawns of the void and their servants in the Holy Land. May the ancestors' spirits be with you!
Farewell!

A Priden? How interesting... Are you the one that has crushed a band of demon-worshippers on Howlem single-handedly?

I'm sorry, I didn't introduce myself. My name is Aidenus, and I'm the Great Mage you are looking for.

Yulia and Sebastian have already told me about the incident when our embassy turned into a battlefield, and the events that followed. So I am happy that you are willing to swear allegiance to the League! I hope one day the rest of your people will join us, too.

But for now - welcome, friend! We need decent warriors in the Holy Land!

Welcome aboard! This ship's destination is Novograd!

By the way, have you ever been to Novograd? It is the best place in the world. You will love it!

I'm glad that the Imperial ambassadors didn't have time to stuff your head with their propaganda. Their promises are as empty as a bottomless bottle! The League will show you the way of the real adventures!

What a surprise... The Golases often refuse to accept Pridens to the Branches because of their stupidity, weakness, or vice. Some of our kinsmen refuse to accept the will of the Golases and leave Howlem voluntarily. But the Golases have never sent anyone to find their destiny in the big world, eysh!

If the Golases think that the path of your life leads you to the Holy Land, you will need some powerful allies. Even the Enlightened can't survive on their own in the big world, eysh!

The Empire or the League? It's up to you to decide. Both have their merits and flaws. Some favor freedom and dignity of the League, some loyalty and cohesion of the Empire.

Remember - once you have chosen one side, you will become enemies with the other one forever. The war between the League and the Empire has been going on for many centuries, and there will be no end to it. When you join a side, you will find your loyal friends... and your deadly enemies!
Ask Tyym-Tulgat the Invincible about the Apologists.

I've been keeping an eye on you, child. Maybe you remember that I was harder on you than on other disciples, zoor? There was a reason.

The Primals are watching over each of the Pridens and mark the most gifted of them. Those marked are destined to face exceptional trials!

One of our greatest Apologists - Tyym-Tulgat the Invincible - will answer your questions. He will help you find your own path!
So, my eyes weren't lying to me, eysh! Very few youngsters are marked with the fate of the Apologist! We have something to talk about.
Ask Tyym-Tulgat the Invincible about the Apologists and complete his trials.

Pridens are strrong people, kylys. But still very few warriors can stand against the Darkness. We spend too much time hunting and nurturing our reckless courage. We respect those who can fearlessly throw themselves at a wild beast or a shard blade. But what is it so honorable in such a thoughtless death?

A skillful warrior is good at killing, not dying, eysh! You are destined to defend your people, and by dying, you will do little good for them!

Luckily, we have a powerful ally to help us. I will tell you about him.

Yes, that was the power of the Gift. You are a quick learner, but don't get too prroud. You are the messenger of Prridens and the shield of your people. Life of an Apologist is an eternal service. There are more scars on their body than stars in the sky, and each of them reminds of the dangers that Pridens are yet to face.

Your deeds make you a hero in the eyes of your people, and you will be long remembered after you die. The chronicles keep the names of each Apologist, and Pridens' faith in our strength is unflinching. Our eagerness to fulfill our duty is only a half of our power. The second half is the trust that our people put in us. Prrove that you are a great warrior, and you will never fall in battle, for they just won't let you, eysh!

Don't forget my lesson, Apologist!
Ask Marina Propagandina about the Trinity Church and its Avengers and Reavers, and also about the differences in the factions' religions.

I've never doubted that there must be those who can use the Holy magic among Pridens! You say you call it "the Gift"?
Well, it is quite accurate. The Gift of Tensess lies at the heart of the Holy Church teaching. The gift of the Great Mage called Tensess made it possible for all believers to resurrect after they die in battle. Haven't this happened here, too? This is really strange. Maybe the ones who can resurrect keep it in secret?
It would be wonderful if someone of your abilities joined the Trinity Church! I can tell you more about, if you wish.
The Church needs strong warriors. Heresy is thriving, and demons, too...
I won't take any more of your time. You have important things to do. Stop by from time to time! It was nice talking to you.
Ask Lazarus Svetlov about the Holy Church and its Crusaders and Reavers, and also about the differences in the factions' religions.

A child of the Light in these wild lands? The Holy Tensess must be guiding you with his shining palm indeed! Make yourself at home. I am Lazarus Svetlov, a servant of the Holy Church, and I welcome you in our humble residence.

I feel the Light blazing in you. Yes, I know that you call it the Gift. We have our Gift, too - the Gift of Tensess. Thanks to the feat of that great man, death does not take our brothers and sisters before the due time.

I can see you have many questions. Please feel free to ask.
Light Works in a Mysterious Way
The Light guides us in the dark. Follow the calling of your heart, and don't forget about your duty to yourself, your people, and the world. I bless you.
Ask Saad-Yuha the Merciful about the Watchers.

I've been watching you, child. Maybe you remember that I was harder on you than on other disciples, zoor? There was a reason.

The Primals are watching over each of the Pridens and mark the most gifted of them. Those marked are destined to face exceptional trials!

One of the most experienced Watchers, Saad-Yuha the Merciful, has been keeping an eye on you. She will help you find your own path.
Aho, child. Nice to meet you.
Aho, child! We've been waiting for you. Listen to what I have to say to those who are about to say goodbye to their childhood and enter their adult life.
The Primals don't favor the weak ones. Show that you can fight!
Khoor-Shashin has taught you a lesson, zoor? That's good. Wounds make us strronger than rock and harder than steel! Now drrink this potion, it will stop the bleeding.
Tell me, whom did you meet in the Thicket of the Primals? What did our ancestors teach you?

Belly symbolizes your inner power. The bear seems to be fat and clumsy, but it's a deceptive imprression. He is smart, strrong, and guileful, but doesn't show it off. He lives in harmony with nature and obeys the Forest Law, which he told you about. He doesn't hunt for fun like we do; he loves nature and only uses its gifts when he can give something in rreturn.

It's a good sign that you met him, eysh!
h: Tell about Belly and the Forest Law

t:
Oh, I haven't met Mirrah, but other trrainers told me about her grace and dexterity. She is strrong and merciless, and she doesn't accept compromise.

The world is crruel, eysh! But we are hunters, and we are in charrge of our lives. The one who resigns to their fate and accepts the inevitable, becomes prey, eysh!
h: Tell about Mirrah and the Power of Blood

t:
Boa, the grreat serpent, the Two-Tongued... He is close to spellcasters, trappers, and trrainers like me. His words are wisdom, eysh! Each trainer has met him in the Thicket of the Primals and learned about the essence of things. This knowledge has led us to understanding the world and ourselves.

It's strrange that you've met spirits that are so different from each other. I think the path of your life will be very winding...
h: Tell about Boa and the essence of things

t:
Scar and Baccy... They are the vice! Anger, prride, lie, and hypocrisy. I told you about death that would be standing by your side. You can't win unless you fight your vice! If you give in to the vice, you will die, if you fight for the virtue, you will win! I'm sure you will choose the latter!

Was there anything else I should know about?
Ask Saad-Yuha the Merciful about the Watchers and pass her trial.

Memory is the most important thing in the history of each people. We, Pridens, sail down the river of time in our own boat. And the Watchers guide that boat. Their will is its oars. Their memory is its anchor. Their knowledge is the beacon that won't let the boat get lost in the mist. We guide our people on the way from the past towards the future through the murky waters of the present.

I can sense the Watcher's talent in you. Your eyes can see even through the impenetrable darkness. The spirits can feel this strength in you, so they hate and fear you. Not only because they can't harm you, but also because you serve the Golases, eysh!

Our path is thorny... But we are not alone. We have our might ally - our faith.

The Gift is shining in your heart like million suns, child. I've never seen anyone so strong in my life, eysh! I'm sure many trrials are waiting for you. But you will cope. I believe in you.

There is something you should know, child. It's a grreat secret, which should not be revealed to our people. The power of the Light did not come from the Primals. Neither have Golases endowed us with it. The Light comes from a different patron... The tailless say that it's a sorcerer called Tensess. But what's in a name? The brighter the Light shines, the stronger is your faith.

While you believe in your strrength, in your ability to resist darkness... You will fight. Our guests believe in Tensess, and the Light shines brrightly in their souls. We believe in the wisdom of the Golases and the grace of the Primals.

And we believe in you, Watcher.
Ask Marina Propagandina about the Trinity Church and its Inquisitors and Heretics, and also about the differences in the factions' religions.
The Church needs miracle workers and missionaries. The Light is the foundation of our faith, but with no spirit of unity, we shall decompound very soon.
I won't take any more of your time. You have important things to do. Stop by from time to time! It was nice talking to you.
Ask Lazarus Svetlov about the Holy Church and its Clerics and Priests, and also about the differences in the factions' religions.
Light Works in a Mysterious Way
The Light guides us in the dark. Follow the calling of your heart, and don't forget about your duty to yourself, your people, and the world. I bless you.
Take a wolf cub from Maas-Lyth in the Saad Camp.

Our land is huge, young kylys. And I believe you won't stay in one place for long, zoor?

My brrood of young wolfs are ready to be saddled for the first time. They are not used to it, so be patient with them. One day they will grrow into real riding beasts, eysh!

From my experience I can say that it is best to adopt cubs while they are still young. What do you say, zoor? If you want to get yourself a faithful frriend, who can take you anywhere on Howlem, you should take one of them, eysh!
Aho, Enlightened! Do you want to make frriends with one of my wolf cubs? Take the strongest and the fastest one, eysh!
Talk to Khoor-Mysk about the deposit box.

Aho, kinsman! You already know about the bank? No? Let me tell you about this brrilliant invention!

The tailless outlanders have showed us how it works. I didn't get it all, but I've learned one thing - here you can store things that you don't need right now, but may find useful later. Just give them to me, and I will keep them safe and sound, eysh!

If there is not enough storage space, you can enlarge your deposit box using tokens from the Boutique. Believe me, it's a good investment - so the outlanders say, and they know these things inside out!
Do you wish to use my services? Come to me at any time of day and night, and I will help you absolutely for free, eysh!
Meet with Yasker in Yasker's Tower.

Hey, freeze! Yes, I'm talking to you. Yasker himself is looking for you. Again!

This must be something secret and very important. I don't even have a letter for you. You better find out what it is as soon as possible.

And don't forget to mention who has found you!
Yes, you are right on time. I have an assignment of an extreme importance for you.
Go to Time Void through the group search. Return to Yasker.

I assume you know nothing about the place called Time Void? I thought so. Very few have heard of it yet, but it is for the best - the land is way too poorly explored. We don't even know its real location, and whether it is an allod or not. Everyone who goes there sees different things, every time. Time Void is changeable and unpredictable, like a desert mirage.

Sorceress Nimra Ozernova has organized an expedition to that place and has asked for my assistance, having promised to provide me with all the information and part of the material valuables, in case she finds any. I agreed to open a Portal for her - it is the only way to get to Time Void.

It has been a month since she left, and I heard nothing from her. I assume that her recklessness has played an evil joke on her, and now she is confined in Time Void with her expedition group.

I need your help to get her out of there. I hope at least she has learned something about that place...

Well... It seems like Time Void has consumed them completely. Maybe there is still hope... But it could be that they all are just vague ghosts now, wandering through its mazes... This is very, very sad.

What do you think about that place? It seems you weren't really impressed. You can try it again, if you want to. Now you know the secret of Time Void. I only hope that you will stay judicious and won't stay there for too long. The Empire needs you.
Meet with Great Mage Aidenus in his tower.

Hey, wait! I have a message for you!

Aidenus wants to see you. As soon as possible! He hasn't even given me any letter for you, so you will have to trust my words.

Go! Don't make him wait!
You are fast! I haven't expected you sooner than by tomorrow morning.
Go to Time Void through the group search. Return to Aidenus.

Have you ever heard of Time Void? A couple of centuries ago anyone could tell you a story about that place. But what is it really, nobody knows - we can't even locate it in the Astral. Even if you get there, next time you won't recognize it, because it changes every time. It used to be quite easy to reach Time Void, but now only the power of the Great Mages can get you there. Mine, for example.

Not so long ago, I helped Nimra Ozernova, a wandering sorceress, organize an expedition to Time Void. I wanted to know the reason why that land has sealed itself from the rest of the world. I suppose, Nimra's expedition was more interested in local treasures.

I haven't heard of her ever since. I am afraid something bad might have happened to her. Time Void guards its secrets zealously! I want to ask you to follow the track of the expedition. Find them, help them, get them out. I will show you how to get in.
Please, hurry up. Time Void is a very dangerous place.

I am afraid that the lost expedition won't make it out of Time Void any time soon. And will they at all? Time Void is a maze with no beginning or end...

I am glad that you alright though. Don't give up on Nimra! Sooner or later you will show her the way. Just don't get stuck in there yourself.

Take part in ten 3x3 rating combats and report to Gaal-Bran the Gloomy in Novograd or Slap the Furious in Yasker’s Tower.

You must complete this quest to keep your rating!

If you fail to complete this quest, your rating will decrease at 5:00 server time.

Want to warm up? Welcome to the arena - its gates are open day and night. Gather your allies and fight for glory!

Once you participate in 10 combats, come back to me. Young fighters are less enthusiastic about fighting these days. They are hungry for gold and gems...  But keep in mind that the true value of a good battle is to keep your body and mind strong! Gems come and go, but glory lives forever!

So fight for honor and glory!
So, how is our champion doing?

I can see that you enjoyed yourself in our arenas! It was a good fight. Keep rejoicing in your victories and learn from your defeats! As we say on Howlem, what does not kill you... may kill you next time!

Here is your reward, friend.  See you next week!
Talk to Slap the Furious about rating combats and participate in them to gain access to the new rewards.

You lookin' for a good fight? We have 'em all!

I'm talking about combats. Their rules are simple. The last survivor's team wins! No capturing checkpoints or banners. Just kill everyone else and survive.

Do you like how it sounds, eh? Will you show 'em how a real  fights?
Ay-hya, that's what I call vigor! I'm sure you will make a great combatant, eysh!
Talk to Gaal-Bran the Gloomy about rating combats and participate in them to gain access to the new rewards.

Aho, warrior! Stop rambling around the world in the search for nasty hunhurrs! Real battles take place here, right under you nose, eysh!

I am talking about combats. Their rules are simple. The last survivor's team wins! No capturing checkpoints or banners. Just kill everyone else and survive.

Participating in combats is amply rewarded with everything a real fighter needs!

How do you like it, zoor? Will you show them how a real  fights?
Ay-hya, that's what I call vigor! I'm sure you will make a great combatant, eysh!
Have your blood tested with the medical tester and report to Sarang Mafoo.

Careful, don't make any sudden moves. Does it hurt elsewhere? Hurts everywhere, you say? That's normal for the condition you're in. Do you feel dizzy? Close your eyes and touch the tip of your nose with your finger. Good, now the other hand. Nice, that's just nice. Congratulations, you weren't killed or even crippled. Although they could and wanted it badly. You owe it to the rebels: you were stunned by the shockwave, but they miraculously dragged you from under the mechanoids' feet and placed you in a boat. Wait a second, don't barrage me with questions! You'll soon be explained everything. Just let me do my job and make sure I stitch you up appropriately. No serious injury. Looks like no contusions either. Now, we'll test your blood for toxins and viruses. There's a tester over there, put your hand in it. It won't hurt. Much.
Can we speed things up? I have many more wounded, and not too much time.
Well, well... Negative for cadaverine, likewise for any pathogenic germs. Congratulations on that.
Connect to illusion, enter the Cave of Elements, fill the bottle with water and bring it to Charles de Doucer in the Refuge.

That's just incredible! You know what the sensors displayed? Nothing! Nothing at all! Once the machine started, your body vanished without a trace. It only came back now that we've returned from the Planar Rim. As for me, only my mind went to the world of illusion, while you were carried away entirely. Do you realize what that can mean?
But no, let's make no hasty conclusions. Now that the idea with the sensors failed, let's carry out a full-fledged scientific experiment. Take this bottle. It's an ordinary lab container that's absolutely empty. Try entering the world of illusion with it. For the time being, the Planar Rim leads only to the Cave of Elements. That's where you should go. Fill the bottle with spring water and get back here. Let's see the extent to which you can violate the border of the worlds.
I always thought I knew reality from fantasy well enough. However, if this experiment is successful, it will mean I knew nothing whatsoever all this time.

Unbelievable. That's water. Clear spring water! Your faith is so strong that you completely immerse into illusory reality. You can even bring quite real items back from there. This is imaginary water, it doesn't exist, but it's here - as if created out of nothing. I don't know what to say. This ruins all I ever knew about reality and illusions... However, that's an unparalleled advantage for the Resistance. This power is our chance to survive and stop Tep.
Return to the Illusory Irdrich and meet with Klavdia Kalugina in Rumbling Bay.

I'll be damned! Looks like Nihaz didn't waste time on you with his stupid Show. I don't believe any of you actually reached enlightenment, but you did learn certain things. Do you know what force allowed you to completely immerse into illusion and take things from there back into reality? The very force the Great Mages use to prevent their allods from being dissolved in the Astral. The very force Sarnaut was once created with. Trust, hope and... Love, you think? Hell no: willpower. It's so alluring to feel like a creating god, right? I wonder how many self-taught tin gods like you are walking around Sarnaut now? And what will remain of it when each one realizes his powers?
But we'll cross that bridge when we get there. For now, the world is threatened by Tep, not you. He wants to become a god real bad - and he's good at creating. Let's go back into his creation and see if it can be turned against its maker. Jump into the sarcophagus - and see you at the Imperial camp!
Welcome back! Spend some time lying in the sun under the palm trees... and think out how to spoil Tep's celebration.
Return to the Illusory Irdrich and meet with Klavdia Kalugina at the Green Cape.

I'll be damned! Looks like Nihaz didn't waste time on you with his stupid Show. I don't believe any of you actually reached enlightenment, but you did learn certain things. Do you know what force allowed you to completely immerse into illusion and take things from there back into reality? The very force the Great Mages use to prevent their allods from being dissolved in the Astral. The very force Sarnaut was once created with. Trust, hope and... Love, you think? Hell no: willpower. It's so alluring to feel like a creating god, right? I wonder how many self-taught tin gods like you are walking around Sarnaut now? And what will remain of it when each one realizes his powers?
But we'll cross that bridge when we get there. For now, the world is threatened by Tep, not you. He wants to become a god real bad - and he's good at creating. Let's go back into his creation and see if it can be turned against its maker. Jump into the sarcophagus - and see you at the League Settlement!
Welcome back! Spend some time lying in the sun under the palm trees... and think out how to spoil Tep's celebration.
Use the orb of invisibility to sneak up to Tep's apostle and kill him.

Everything's bad. Everything's very, very bad. There's a mole in the Resistance that gave Tep the Refuge's coordinates. He even remembered to mention the mined bridges. Tep sent an elite assault squad here. They already arrived.
We repelled the first charge, but we won't last another one. Just now, the assault troops retreated to regroup. We need a miracle, or all your victories in the illusory world will be worth nothing. There will be no one there to fight the weakened Tep.
Fortunately, Spike and you already secured something of that sort. Remember the orb of invisibility? Here it is. We've tested it a few times already - it works with clockwork precision. While invisible, you'll be able to get through the lines of assault troops right to their leader. Fortunately, Tep's servants - machines and cultists alike - can't move until given orders. Kill him, that will give us a chance.
Tep likes obedient servants that don't reason. Let's see how they will fight when there's no one around to give orders!
They're retreating! You can officially declare yourself a miracle worker. While Tep is gathering a new squad, we'll make our move.
Kill 8 Assault Cultists and 8 Striking or Supporting Mechanoids.

I heard Klavdia's plan. It's worth trying: we have no other options whatsoever. By the way, do you know where's she from? Is she Xadaganian or Kanian? She wasn't on any of the Imperial ships, but nobody from the League knows her either...
Never mind, no time to talk now, I'll find it out later. Here's the thing: if she's right, then without their commander, taking care of the assault troops will be a piece of cake. This is our chance to lessen their numbers: once you kill him, we'll launch a counterattack. But don't you let up either - destroy as many cultists and mechanoids as possible! Don't engage while their commander is alive: he's your main target, and they're called elite for a reason.
Still, where does this Klavdia come from?
We made it! The assault troops are fleeing! This isn't a victory yet, but another chance at least.
Relay to Charles de Doucer, Fleur de Ardeur, Feodor Strokov and Sarang Mafoo false information about moving the Refuge.

Now we need to find out who betrayed us. I have a few suspects in mind. The first one is, of course, Charles de Doucer. He did help us, but maybe that was all part of the plan? Then there's Fleur de Ardeur. She appeared at a very opportune moment, almost so as to be rescued by Spike and you. Could it be a coincidence? The third one is Feodor Strokov. He's just too sociable and inquisitive, always asking lots of questions. And a chatterbox is what? Right, a godsend for a spy! Lastly there's Sarang Mafoo. He won't let anyone come close to his equipment - he says it's for sanitary reasons and sterility... What if he has a transmitter there?
Which of them is the mole? Let's do this: we'll plant some misinformation. Go tell each of them that we're planning to move the Refuge. Tell Charles the new Refuge will be in the Tower Ruins; for Fleur, it will be the Ship Graveyard; lie to Feodor about the Dump and mislead Mafoo about the Isle of Perils. Then all we have to do is check all four areas and see where the ambush will be.
Now don't screw this up! And of course, not a word about it to anyone!
Whichever is the traitor, the bait has been swallowed. Let's proceed to the second phase of the plan.
Visit the four islands, find an ambush on one of them, destroy it and report to Artem Sonin at the Refuge.

Let's proceed to the second phase of the operation. We need to visit all four areas. In one of them, there will be enemies waiting for you. This is a dangerous task, so take this orb of invisibility. The ambush must be located swiftly and every single fighter must be eliminated, lest the enemy warn their informant. Any questions? Then get down to it!
What a piece of garbage one must be to give away one's allies, living creatures, to Tep! That bastard walks among us and shares our bread! Yuck!
The Dump. So it was Strokov. You're gonna get it, traitor!
What a rat bastard! I ordered all exits closed so he has nowhere to run. Arrest the traitor and bring him to me. I will conduct an interrogation. The rigorous kind.

First Baranov, then Strokov... I hate to admit it, but I seem to have gotten used to seeing treason everywhere I look, expecting everyone to stab me in the back. Once we come home, I'll quit the goddamn service and start growing grains or casting steel.

How could he flee? Where? Into illusion, you say? What a sleazeball! If he went there with his body, like you, then he's got enough willpower and confidence. That, however, serves only one purpose: his own belly!
Explore the Dump and find a way to get to the Eastern Outpost.

The Refuge has been discovered, but there's no point in moving it anymore. This guerilla war is coming to an end, and we'll soon have to engage in an open fight against Tep. He has lost his support from the illusory world and his elite assault squad - this gives us a fighting chance. It's too early to attack head on, though. First, we need to free all those who are still kept in his dungeon or sleeping in gilded coffins. That requires time, which we are short of.
We'll try to win a few hours by attacking the infrastructure. Acts of sabotage in the factories will distract Tep from us and weaken his army. We need to find pathways to the enemy's rear. Our scouts report that Tep's troops are using some invisible energy bridges to move from their fortifications to the main part of Irdrich. Go to the Eastern Outpost, locate that bridge and find out how to get across!
There must be a power bridge here. Here's the control console! We can fiddle around with it while the guards are away.
Run to the Refuge exit and back to Sarang Mafoo in the infirmary.

Wonderful. Save for the bruises and scratches, you're healthier than an Octulhu. However, a few more tests will do no harm. How's your heart? Any trouble with it? You'll see things here that'll cause even a healthy one to suffer a stroke. Let's do an electrocardiogram. Put this around your arm and jog to the Refuge exit. You'll also see how things are here.
Go on, run! There and back! And don't try to cheat. It's YOUR heart we're testing, not someone else's.
Well, well, let's see the cardiogram... Wow, that's a pleasant sight! You have a heart like a power plant!
Report your arrival to Artem Sonin.

Congratulations, anyone will envy your health. I formally discharge you from the resort. You can go back to serving your righteous cause, whatever that may be.
Now go, I have more than enough work to do. The infirmary is no place for rest. Report to Artem Sonin, he's in charge here. Ask him whatever you want to know, 'cause your questions are making my head explode.
There you are. Everything intact? Then congratulations on your awakening.
First things first, let me explain the mess we find ourselves in. I don't even know where to start... OK, how about this: you ask and I'll answer.
This is hard to believe, but try to anyway.
Exterminate all of Tep Blades in the Refuge.

Wait, wait... Hear that siren? Alert! That's Tep's search squad! They're here already!
If even one of the scouts makes it back to his master, a whole army of machines and cultists will be here within minutes. We need to exterminate all of them pronto!
Don't delay! If they expose us, the Resistance will be done for!
Another thearch thquad gone missing. Thooner or later, they'll figure it out and come here. Our only chance ith overthrowing the entire thystem before they do.
